$comment: Brand-and-claim rules for luvita.tr (luvita-docs#9, EmirErs W7). Run after `npm run build`: python3 .github/scripts/brand-check.py. Schema: https://github.com/AnunnakiCosmoCrew/project-templates/tree/main/actions/brand-claim-check

rules.why: adr/0005: https://luvita.tr/ is a real identity page, never a redirect; the previous stub cost a credit-programme round.

rules.pattern: Luvita Teknoloji Enerji Yazılım Sanayi ve Ticaret Limited Şirketi
rules.why: adr/0005: the root identity card carries the registered trade name in the HTML the server sends.
adr/0005: the root page carries the MERSİS number for a verifier running curl (LUVITA.md, Legal entity).
adr/0005: the root page carries contact@luvita.tr in server-sent HTML.

rules.pattern: <script type="application/ld\+json">\{[^<]*"legalName":"Luvita Teknoloji Enerji Yazılım Sanayi ve Ticaret Limited Şirketi"
rules.why: adr/0005: Organization JSON-LD ships from BaseHead on every page because we do not choose where a verifier lands. The two retired-route stubs (LW-12 redirects) are excluded.
CLAUDE.md / adr/0006: never set redirectToDefaultLocale: true again; Astro would generate the root itself and ignore the identity page.
LUVITA.md, Legal entity: the registered office is the founder's home; the street address is never published on our own surfaces (rule inventory 54/118).
CLAUDE.md (LW-17): no company address in rendered page text, not even the city; LOCATION survives only in the JSON-LD address block. Matches text nodes only.

LUVITA.md: luvita.tr shows no city at all (LW-17), and that includes the snippet a search result or a link preview shows: no description / og:description / twitter:description names Bodrum or Muğla. Founder decision 2026-10-07 (luvita-docs#9); the root page's description was reworded in the same PR. The city survives only in the JSON-LD address block (no-city-in-visible-copy).

rules.pattern: Luvita Teknoloji Enerji|Teknoloji Enerji Yazılım|LUVİTA TEKNOLOJİ ENERJİ
allow: "legalName":"Luvita Teknoloji Enerji Yazılım Sanayi ve Ticaret Limited Şirketi"
>Luvita Teknoloji Enerji Yazılım Sanayi ve Ticaret Limited Şirketi

rules.why:
CLAUDE.md / adr/0003 (amended by adr/0005): the full trade name is legal identity, never copy; only the exact registered form, in the footer legal block, the root identity block and JSON-LD legalName. Allowed only in context: the JSON-LD legalName, a whole

(footer legal block, root identity block) or the data-controller line of the legal pages; the name inside a headline, a lead or any other element is caught.

CLAUDE.md: the trade name must never appear in a description meta tag (name=description, og:description, twitter:description), the snippet a search result or a link preview shows (rule inventory 56). Attribute order does not matter.
adr/0003: the consumer solar brand never appears on luvita.tr; the vitrines stay separate (LUVITA.md, Brands).
adr/0003: no GES/solar content in the site body; the guard the ADR asked for (`GES|güneş|solar` outside the legal constants).
CLAUDE.md / adr/0006: zero client-side JS; a <script>, an inline on* handler or a javascript: URL on any page but the root is a regression. JSON-LD is data, not script.

allow:
<script>(function(){const trHref = "/tr/";
const enHref = "/en/";

      // Progressive enhancement (adr/0006): forward JS browsers to their
      // language — Turkish PRIMARY preference → /tr/, everything else → /en/.
      // Keying on the single most-preferred language (not "Turkish appears
      // anywhere") keeps an English-primary bilingual visitor on /en/. No-JS
      // clients and crawlers keep the identity card below. No cookies, no
      // external request. `replace` leaves no history entry (no back trap).
      try {
        var primary =
          (navigator.languages && navigator.languages[0]) ||
          navigator.language ||
          '';
        var prefersTr = /^tr\b/i.test(primary);
        window.location.replace(prefersTr ? trHref : enHref);
      } catch (e) {}
    })();</script>
rules.why: adr/0006: the root page carries exactly one inline script, the locale redirect, allow-listed here verbatim as built; any other script, a changed redirect, an inline handler or a javascript: URL on the root is caught. Editing src/pages/index.astro's script means updating the allow entry in the same PR.
CLAUDE.md: no external requests; the root redirect is inline and loads no library.

CLAUDE.md: no external requests at all, not just no known trackers: every resource-bearing element and CSS url()/@import must be same-origin. <link rel=canonical|alternate> are non-fetching SEO links and stay allowed.
CLAUDE.md: no analytics, no fonts, no CDN embeds; the privacy pages promise no cookies and no tracking.
LUVITA.md, Brands: LexiPower never "WordPower", Umay never "Yaren" in public (rule inventory 58).
adr/0004: product company only; the Services page was retired (LW-12) and nothing may link to it again.
